notes: Temps on the lower end of the river have decreased over the past week and are now touching the underside of 67 F. No solid reports from anyone fishing, but generally fishing above around Dunsmuir should be solid. With the storms this week you should see epic BWO and midge hatches, bring your dry box! This is little black bug season on the Upper, so Zebras in #18 or smaller, BP Weiss nymphs, black S&Ms, black Micro Mays and any other teeny, tiny nymph chucked into the frothy stuff is the best tactic during the day. Midges are always a good idea to fish. Towards dark you can head hunt with smaller dark Missing links and Adams. The browns are moving up the river from the lake, so bring a streamer rod. Always have Rubberlegs, Perdigons, BP Weiss Nymphs, Poopahs, Zebra Midges and Bird's Nests to round out your offerings. Upper Sacramento Flows at Delta

FOR THE GUIDE, Upper Sac: 2 numbers only you can set -- a wading limit ("wadeable below X CFS"). Until then the card shows where the flow sits in this river's own record for the date and gives no wading verdict, because a verdict with no number behind it is a safety claim we have not earned; and how long a report on this water stays current, and how long before it reads as older. The card is running 14 and 30 days as an INTERIM -- chosen to fit how this page actually reads, not from any standard, and it is a placeholder until you say.
